queries.description: COUNTIF with JOIN - count returned orders per product
queries.sql: SELECT {products}.product_name, COUNTIF({orders}.is_returned) FROM {orders} JOIN {products} ON {orders}.product_id = {products}.product_id GROUP BY {products}.product_name ORDER BY {products}.product_name

queries.description: COUNTIF with JOIN - filter on join column value
COUNTIF with JOIN mixed with other aggs
queries.sql: SELECT {products}.product_name, COUNT(*), COUNTIF({orders}.amount > 100), SUM({orders}.amount) FROM {orders} JOIN {products} ON {orders}.product_id = {products}.product_id GROUP BY {products}.product_name ORDER BY {products}.product_name

queries.description: COUNTIF with JOIN matches COUNT FILTER equivalent - returned orders per product
queries.sql: SELECT {products}.product_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE {orders}.is_returned) FROM {orders} JOIN {products} ON {orders}.product_id = {products}.product_id GROUP BY {products}.product_name ORDER BY {products}.product_name

queries.description: COUNTIF with JOIN matches COUNT FILTER equivalent - amount filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNTIF({orders}.amount > 100), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE {orders}.amount > 100) FROM {orders} JOIN {products} ON {orders}.product_id = {products}.product_id

countif with equality predicate (2 rows have string_col = 'a')
countif with boolean column (3 rows have bool_col = true)
countif with AND predicate (3 rows: 101, 150, 175 have int_col > 10 AND string_col = 'c')
countif with OR predicate (string_col = 'a': 2 rows, int_col > 100: 3 rows, union: 5)
countif that matches no rows returns 0
countif that matches all rows
multiple countifs in same query
countif mixed with other aggregations
countif with WHERE clause (only b,c rows: 3,100,101,150,175; of those int_col > 10: 100,101,150,175)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(int_col > 10) FROM {tbl} WHERE string_col IN ('b', 'c')

queries.description: countif with GROUP BY (a: 0 rows > 10, b: 1 row > 10, c: 3 rows > 10)
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNTIF(int_col > 10) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col ORDER BY string_col

queries.description: countif with GROUP BY and ORDER BY result
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNTIF(int_col > 10) AS cnt FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col ORDER BY cnt DESC

queries.description: countif mixed with other aggs and GROUP BY
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNT(*), COUNTIF(int_col > 10), SUM(double_col) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col ORDER BY string_col

queries.description: multiple countifs with GROUP BY
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNTIF(int_col > 10), COUNTIF(bool_col) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col ORDER BY string_col

queries.description: count_if underscore variant
countif with function in predicate (MOD) - 2,2,100,150 are even
countif vs count filter equivalence
queries.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(int_col > 10), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE int_col > 10) FROM {tbl}

queries.description: countif vs count filter equivalence in same query
queries.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(int_col > 10), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE int_col > 10) FROM {tbl}

queries.description: countif with alias
countif in arithmetic expression (4 rows > 10, 0 rows < 0, sum = 4)
countif arithmetic matches FILTER equivalent
queries.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(int_col > 10) + COUNTIF(int_col < 0), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE int_col > 10) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE int_col < 0) FROM {tbl}

queries.description: countif in ORDER BY expression directly
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNTIF(int_col > 10) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col ORDER BY COUNTIF(int_col > 10) DESC

queries.description: countif in CASE WHEN expression
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNTIF(int_col > 10) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM {tbl}

queries.description: countif in COALESCE
countif in CAST
countif in ABS with subtraction
countif with HAVING - filter groups by count result (a:0, b:1, c:3; only b and c have > 0)
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNTIF(int_col > 10) AS cnt FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col HAVING cnt > 0 ORDER BY string_col

queries.description: COUNT FILTER with HAVING - equivalent to COUNTIF HAVING
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE int_col > 10) AS cnt FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col HAVING cnt > 0 ORDER BY string_col

queries.description: countif in HAVING clause directly
queries.sql: SELECT string_col FROM {tbl} GROUP BY string_col HAVING COUNTIF(int_col > 10) > 0 ORDER BY string_col

queries.description: countif with WHERE and HAVING combined
queries.sql: SELECT string_col, COUNTIF(int_col > 10) AS cnt FROM {tbl} WHERE double_col < 200 GROUP BY string_col HAVING cnt > 0 ORDER BY string_col
